Specification: This module defines record-valued alias mappings related to the DieHard specification by extending the DieHard module. It does not introduce any new state variables, actions, or temporal properties; instead, it provides three top-level record constructors. Two records include commented-out fields, and a third includes all listed fields plus an extra mapping to TLCGet("level").
RecordConstructor:
[
    bigBucket    |-> bigBucket,
    smallBucket  |-> smallBucket,
    action       |-> action,
    water_to_pour|-> water_to_pour,
    extraVar     |-> TLCGet("level")
]
